definition: Dated government support, resource-access reports and policy targets. Different units, instruments, currencies and scopes are not ranked or added together.

observations.name: InvestAI
observations.label: €200bn mobilization target
observations.note: European Commission announcement; includes a €20bn gigafactory fund. Public/private mobilization target, not €200bn of government spending or proof of disbursement.
observations.rights: Factual summary attributed to the European Commission; no source artwork or prose reproduced.
observations.summary: Public and private investment target, including a €20bn gigafactory fund.

observations.name: AI Growth Zones
observations.label: 5 zones designated
observations.note: UK government one-year progress report, January 2026. Designation is an infrastructure-policy milestone, not measured productivity, completed construction or jobs created. This is a dated milestone, not a claim about today’s total.
observations.rights: Factual summary attributed to UK DSIT, Crown copyright, Open Government Licence v3.0.
observations.summary: A dated infrastructure milestone, reported by the UK government.

observations.name: IndiaAI Mission
observations.label: ₹10,371.92 crore approved outlay
observations.summary: Compute access, skills, datasets and startup support in one national mission.
observations.note: Cabinet-approved five-year programme budget of INR 10,371.92 crore (INR 103.7192 billion). Display rounded to INR 103.7bn. Approval is not proof of disbursement or completed infrastructure.
observations.rights: Independent factual summary attributed to Government of India, Press Information Bureau; no source artwork reproduced.

observations.name: AI advantage package
observations.label: C$2.4bn announced AI package
observations.summary: Includes C$2bn for compute access and infrastructure, alongside adoption and skills measures.
observations.note: Prime Minister announcement of a CAD 2.4 billion package ahead of Budget 2024; includes CAD 2 billion for compute. Different components have different implementation windows. Announced support, not verified expenditure.
observations.rights: Independent factual summary attributed to Prime Minister of Canada; no source artwork reproduced.

observations.name: AI infrastructure investment
observations.label: €109bn investment announcements
observations.summary: Infrastructure and deployment projects announced around the Paris AI Action Summit.
observations.note: Élysée reported EUR 109 billion of investment announcements for infrastructure and deployment projects in France. Not an annual government AI budget or confirmed disbursement. May overlap with broader European initiatives; do not sum with InvestAI.
observations.rights: Independent factual summary attributed to the French Presidency; no source artwork reproduced.

observations.name: AI Research & Development
observations.label: Over S$1bn additional research investment
observations.summary: Additional public AI research support under the national R&D plan.
observations.note: MDDI announced additional investment of over SGD 1 billion over five years, 2025–2030, in the NAIRD Plan. Value is a strict lower bound, not the exact allocation. Kept separate from the 2024 NAIS 2.0 package; no combined total inferred.
observations.rights: Independent factual summary attributed to Singapore MDDI; no source artwork reproduced.

observations.name: Shared AI research infrastructure
observations.label: More than 600 research teams supported
observations.summary: NAIRR provides shared compute, models and data; NSF also reports over 6,000 students supported.
observations.statusLabel: Reported access · not a productivity measure
observations.note: NSF two-year progress update dated March 19, 2026 reports more than 600 research teams and 6,000 students supported since 2024 across all US states, DC and Puerto Rico. Counts describe resource access, not completed AI deployment or causal economic effects. Not a current live total.
observations.rights: Independent factual summary attributed to U.S. National Science Foundation; no source artwork reproduced.

observations.name: AI & semiconductor framework
observations.label: Over ¥10tn public-support framework through FY2030
observations.summary: Support for both AI and semiconductors, including subsidies, investment and guarantees.
observations.note: Japan Cabinet economic measures of November 22, 2024 specify more than JPY 10 trillion in public support over seven years through FY2030, including around JPY 6 trillion in subsidies/commissions and more than JPY 4 trillion in financial support. This includes semiconductor industry support, is not AI-only spending, and is not verified expenditure. Do not add guarantees to spending as if identical instruments.
observations.rights: Independent factual summary attributed to Japan Cabinet Office and METI; no source artwork reproduced.

observations.name: AI Plus initiative
observations.label: Over 70% target for intelligent terminals and agents by 2027
observations.summary: A policy target for smart terminals and AI agents, with integration across six priority sectors.
observations.note: State Council guideline reported August 27, 2025 targets penetration of new-generation intelligent terminals and AI agents above 70% by 2027 and 90% by 2030. The source provides a broad policy target, not a methodologically defined enterprise-survey observation. It is not comparable to Eurostat business AI adoption. No achieved percentage is inferred.
observations.rights: Independent factual summary of policy targets, attributed to China State Council. No source text, image or original artwork reproduced.
